parameters.content:
## We Work Remotely Job Listings & Salary Extractor

**Actor:** [We Work Remotely Job Listings & Salary Extractor](https://apify.com/dataspryva/we-work-remotely-job-listings-and-salary-extractor)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/we-work-remotely-job-listings-and-salary-extractor.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `categories` (array)
- `searchTerm` (string)
- `startUrls` (array)
- `employmentTypes` (array)
- `regions` (array)
- `countries` (array)
- `postedWithin` (string)
- `minSalary` (integer)
- `maxSalary` (integer)
- `requireSalary` (boolean)
- `includeDescription` (boolean)

### Output fields
- `title` (Title)
- `company` (Company)
- `category` (Category)
- `salary` (Salary)
- `postedAt` (Posted At)
- `url` (Url)

description: We Work Remotely job listings scraper: runs the We Work Remotely Job Listings & Salary Extractor Apify Actor, returns title, company, category, salary, postedAt and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
